## Context
`.github/mutation-shards.toml` currently treats recursive `tests/**/conftest.py` as global support, so a change to any nested conftest selects all seven mutation shards. Across 97 recent completed Verify runs, seven proven candidate over-triggers consumed 322.6 runner-minutes (5.38 runner-hours) without increasing coverage. A top-level `tests/conftest.py` change genuinely affects all shards, but pytest only loads conftests in a test's directory and its ancestors—never sibling fixture trees. A runtime trace over every configured shard found the complete loaded ancestor union is exactly six files: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/unit/conftest.py`, `tests/interfaces/conftest.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/conftest.py`, `tests/scripts/conftest.py`, and `tests/scripts/reducer/conftest.py`. The union of all shard tests still passes (374 passed, 1 skipped in 23.30s).

## Prior decisions and OSS research
No tracker ticket contains or rejects this exact proposal. `frowsy-beggarly-mammoth` rejected deleting a whole workflow from global support because that loses coverage; this change retains every dynamically loaded fixture dependency. `nostalgic-crumby-tick` requires support-input mapping, true mutation-infrastructure changes selecting all shards, isolated evidence, and no verdict cache; this satisfies those constraints. Three active OSS projects converge on dependency-accurate affected-test selection: pytest documents upward-only conftest discovery; Jest uses inverse dependency resolution for `--findRelatedTests`; Nx maps changed support inputs to owning/dependent projects while reserving true-global inputs for all targets. Consensus approval therefore applies only with per-shard ownership and a fail-closed drift contract.

## Plan
- Remove the recursive conftest global-support pattern. Keep only `tests/conftest.py` as true global conftest support.
- Put `tests/unit/conftest.py` in the per-shard support lists for signing, compact-policy, and push-policy only.
- Put `tests/interfaces/conftest.py` in the per-shard support lists for signing, reducer-processors, gates, next-batch, and validate only; signing loads it through `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_signature.py`.
- Put `tests/interfaces/store/conftest.py`, `tests/scripts/conftest.py`, and `tests/scripts/reducer/conftest.py` in reducer-processors support only.
- Add a deterministic contract that expands each shard's configured test files/directories, derives their present ancestor conftests, and asserts the per-shard manifest support closure equals that derived set while the true-global root remains global.
- Add selection cases proving unrelated nested conftests select no shard and each declared ancestor selects exactly its dependent shards.
- Extend the manifest contract to pin all existing non-conftest global-support entries and each shard's existing source/tests arrays, proving this edit does not alter unrelated mappings or true mutation-infrastructure triggers.
- Prove fail-closed drift by defect-seeding a missing derived ancestor or stale extra conftest entry and observing the contract fail.
- Run focused mutation selector/contracts, the union of configured shard tests, lint, typecheck, and workflow/action policy gates.
- If post-merge evidence exposes an unmodeled fixture dependency, revert this single Gerrit change to restore the recursive fail-safe, then add the dependency to the derived contract before retrying.
- Land through Gerrit and measure avoided mutation runner occupancy on a later unrelated nested-conftest change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The manifest keeps only `tests/conftest.py` as conftest global support and contains no recursive conftest glob.
- [ ] Each non-root ancestor conftest appears only in the support lists of shards whose configured tests load it.
- [ ] Signing support includes both `tests/unit/conftest.py` and `tests/interfaces/conftest.py`.
- [ ] A contract derives and compares the per-shard ancestor-conftest closure from configured shard test paths.
- [ ] The contract fails on a missing dependency or stale extra conftest entry.
- [ ] An unrelated nested conftest change selects no mutation shard.
- [ ] Each true ancestor conftest change selects exactly its dependent mutation shards.
- [ ] A contract pins every pre-existing shard source/tests mapping unchanged.
- [ ] A contract pins every pre-existing non-conftest global trigger unchanged.
- [ ] All configured shard tests execute with unchanged pass/skip results.
- [ ] Focused tests, lint, typecheck, and applicable workflow guards pass.
- [ ] Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 precede merge.
